other_conditions: Farmer must be identified under the Saat Nischay-2 “Irrigation Water to Every Field” after a joint technical survey.
Must own at least 0.40 acre (40 decimal) of land.
No existing borewell should be present at the proposed site.
No previous grants or financial assistance for borewell construction at the same site may have been taken by the farmer.
The grant is limited to one borewell and one motor pump set per farmer.
Borewell must be dug to a depth of 15‑70 meters with a diameter of 4‑6 inch.
After approval, the borewell must be dug within 60 days and relevant photos uploaded on the portal.
Photographs of the borewell site, water flow, and motor pump installation must be uploaded in JPEG/PNG format.
All materials used for the tube‑well must be manufactured in India and meet Indian quality standards.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy for borewell construction (₹600‑₹900 per meter depending on caste category) and for motor pump installation (50‑80% of pump cost up to ₹30,000).
documents_required: Photographs of borewell site and motor pump installation (JPEG/PNG)
